campaigns.title: The baseline runs the suite in parallel and still reports what failed

mutants.breaks: the defect restored exactly: the nightly's largest single cost goes from 77s back to 291s, 3.8x, for a flag the other whole-suite runner has always passed

NFR-1: an already-broken tree stops being attributable, so `verdict_of` cannot mark the affected mutants INDETERMINATE and reports them as unprotected requirements instead — a finding that blames the corpus for a failure it did not cause
